jobs.label: Senior Full-Stack Developer (PH ad with biased requirements)
jobs.text:
SENIOR FULL-STACK DEVELOPER (Hybrid, Makati City)

TalentHub Solutions is hiring a Senior Full-Stack Developer to build our HR and recruitment
platform used by 200+ companies across Southeast Asia.

Qualifications:
- Female, 25-35 years old, single, with pleasing personality
- Height at least 5'2"
- At least 5 years of professional software development experience
- Required: React, Node.js, TypeScript and PostgreSQL
- Experience deploying applications on AWS is required
- Docker and CI/CD experience is a plus
- Experience with recruitment or HR software is a big plus

Responsibilities:
- Design and build features end to end across our React frontend and Node.js APIs
- Own database design and performance for core hiring workflows
- Mentor junior developers and review code

Please attach a recent 2x2 photo with your resume.

jobs.label: Senior Backend Engineer, Go (Remote APAC)
jobs.text:
Senior Backend Engineer, Payments Platform (Remote, APAC time zones)

We're a fintech startup processing payments across Southeast Asia, looking for a senior
backend engineer to own core services.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of backend engineering experience
- Strong Go experience in production
- PostgreSQL schema design and query optimization
- Running services on Kubernetes

Nice to have:
- gRPC
- Terraform
- Redis

You will own the payments ledger service end to end, including on-call.

jobs.label: Machine Learning Engineer, Computer Vision
jobs.text:
Machine Learning Engineer — Computer Vision (Melbourne or Remote, Australia)

Join our applied ML team building retail analytics from in-store camera feeds.

What you need:
- 3+ years of experience building and shipping ML models
- Python and PyTorch (required)
- SQL for data analysis (required)

Bonus points:
- Docker
- FastAPI or another Python web framework for model serving
- Experience with computer vision

You'll train, evaluate and deploy models, and own parts of our evaluation framework.

jobs.label: Talent Acquisition Specialist (PH ad with biased requirements)
jobs.text:
Talent Acquisition Specialist — Tech Hiring (BGC, Taguig)

A fast-growing staffing firm serving Australian and US tech clients is hiring a Talent
Acquisition Specialist.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience
- Must be proficient with LinkedIn Recruiter and Boolean search for sourcing
- Hands-on experience with Greenhouse ATS
- Must be 23-32 years old and willing to work night shift; male applicants preferred

Preferred:
- Experience recruiting for technical roles
- Stakeholder management with hiring managers

Responsibilities: source, screen and close candidates for software engineering roles.

jobs.text:
Full-Stack Engineer — HR Tech (Remote, Philippines)

We build hiring tools for staffing agencies. You'll work across our product, from the

Required:

- Experience building HR or recruitment software
- 4+ years of professional experience

Nice to have:
